conviction_note: Mild long lean, p_up 56 x abs 14 = +1.68. The lean rests on two things. First, an inference from company documents: Q3 is HEMANGEOL's first full quarter, and revenue is booked on patient orders with no channel fill. Second, the guide pattern: raised in each 2026 print, and consensus H2 already sits above the >$145M guide. The run is +200% YTD, the stock is 23.5% off its high, insiders have sold ~$25M and the $10M LIBERVANT upfront may weigh on the EBITDA-margin guide, so p_up stays near 50. impact_sum (+2.7) and the scaled number (+1.7) agree in sign. The gap is the uncertainty about the reaction, which is held in p_up.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $42.2M and EPS $0.34. Sources: Earnings Whispers preview dated 2026-10-29 (https://finviz.com/news/411835/etons-first-full-hemangiol-quarter-tests-whether-a-145-million-guide-was-conservative) and the Benzinga forecast page (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ETON/earnings-forecasts, seen via search snippet; the page returned 403), which agree on $42.2M, with Q4 at $46.1M. An outlier Earnings Whispers page shows $30.72M, and a stale FY consensus of $120.2M also circulates; both are disregarded. Company guide: FY2026 revenue >$145M, adj. EBITDA margin >=35%, adj. gross margin >70% (Q2 8-K, 2026-08-13, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001710340/000143774926027672/ex_974033.htm). H1 actual is $61.9M, so the guide implies H2 >$83.1M (~$41.5M a quarter). Consensus H2 of $88.3M already sits above the guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 1.94M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, ~3.3 days to cover (massive.com, https://massive.com/quote/eton, page as of 2026-11-04). That is ~6.8% of 28.58M shares outstanding and up from 1.83M at 2026-09-30, so not crowded. 25-delta skew: null in the baseline. Put/call open interest is 0.21 (call-heavy). Implied move is 20.4%, but the ATM spread is 75% of mid, so it is indicative only. ATM IV is 125% against 31% 20-day realised. Tape: -8.2% over 5d, -10.0% over 20d, -23.5% from the 52-week high, +243% from the 52-week low. Insiders sold about $25.4M over 12 months with no buys, CEO ~$9.9M (100k shares at $60.88, filed 2026-08-20).

findings.finding: Q3 is HEMANGEOL's first full quarter, after only May-June in Q2. The 10-Q says revenue is recognised as product ships against patient orders, so Q2 carried no channel fill. Q2 revenue rose $13.3M sequentially ($24.3M to $37.6M, of which $2.9M was ex-US INCRELEX), which implies HEMANGEOL ran at ~$5.5-6.5M a month by June. Management puts net price at $8-10k per patient on ~8,000 patients a year (~$64-80M annualised). A full quarter of that on a ~$23-25M US base points to ~$43-45M Q3 revenue against the $42.2M consensus, a 2-6% beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have been bought. Q2 2026 printed $37.6M against ~$27.2M consensus with a raise and the stock rose +44.3%. Q1 2026 ($24.3M) moved +1.0%. Q3 2025 had revenue above estimates but a gross margin drop to 45% and a payer-mix comment, and the stock fell -11.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus of $42.2M is only ~12% above Q2 even though Q3 has 3 HEMANGEOL months against 2. The preview itself says it has no HEMANGEOL run-rate. If the full-quarter arithmetic were priced, consensus would sit at $44M+ and the stock would not be sitting at its post-earnings low ($48.36 low, $49.28 spot).
findings.independence: Draws on several documents. Net price and patient count come from Q2 call summaries (https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/ETON/2026/Q2, snippet; page returned 429). HEMANGEOL had only $11.7M of 2025 sales (IQVIA) under Pierre Fabre (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1710340/000143774926006209/eton20260223c_8k.htm), so the increment comes from Eton's repricing. This is an inference from company documents and is not a reported HEMANGEOL figure.

findings.finding: The guide is >$145M FY revenue and >=35% adj. EBITDA margin. Against it: H1 actual $61.9M plus consensus Q3 $42.2M and Q4 $46.1M comes to $150.2M, and Q2 adj. EBITDA margin was 43%. Eton raised revenue guidance at every 2026 print (>$110M to >$120M to >$145M). The market therefore needs a raise to at least ~$150M; a reiteration would read as a soft cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus already embeds a beat of the guide. The stock has de-rated 26% from its $66.37 high into the print, which is what a priced-in raise would not look like. Call-heavy open interest (P/C 0.21) shows some upside positioning.
findings.independence: Shares the Q2 8-K with the first finding, but rests on a different number (the guide, not the HEMANGEOL run rate). Consensus Q4 $46.1M comes from the Benzinga forecast snippet; the Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/411835/...) calls the margin guide cautious.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-13 Eton licensed US rights to LIBERVANT (diazepam buccal film; tentative FDA approval only) from Aquestive. Terms: $10M upfront, up to $47.5M in milestones, mid-teens royalties, launch expected April 2027. With no final approval, the upfront is likely an expense in Q4. ASN-001's $3M was expensed and included in adjusted EBITDA guidance. $10M is ~6-7 points of FY EBITDA margin, which pressures any raise to the >=35% margin guide. Cash was $26.8M at 2026-06-30 against $28M of debt, offset by $14.7M of H1 operating cash flow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print has carried a large in-licensing upfront on the EBITDA guide. The ASN-001 $3M was disclosed alongside the 2026-08-13 raise (+44%).
findings.why_not_priced: The 8-K gives no accounting treatment and no guidance impact. The Q4 consensus margin cannot have absorbed a $10M expense the company has not quantified. If it were priced, Q4 EPS estimates would have been cut after 10-14; consensus Q3 EPS is $0.34 and no revisions were found. Financing question: the money buys a 2027 launch into a >$450M seizure-rescue market, funded from operating cash flow. That is not distress, so this is a small margin-guide negative only.
findings.independence: Terms are corroborated by Sidley's Aquestive-side note (https://www.sidley.com/ja/newslanding/newsannouncements/2026/10/sidley-represents-aquestive-therapeutics-in-exclusive-us-licensing-agreement) and Panabee (https://www.panabee.com/news/eton-pharmaceuticals-adds-450-million-seizure-rescue-opportunity-with-libervant-license). The accounting is my inference.

findings.finding: Ex-US INCRELEX sales are lumpy and margin-dilutive: $2.9M in Q2 2026 (with Q2 2025 adj. gross margin dropping to 45%). In Q3 2025 the company said some ex-US INCRELEX revenue would not recur regularly. A missing or smaller ex-US shipment in Q3 2026 would swing ~5-7% of the $42.2M bar either way and would distort gross margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: the margin drop tied to ex-US distribution coincided with a -11.7% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus models a smooth +12% sequential line, but this line is not smooth. If the risk were priced, the revenue estimates would show a wide spread; the only spread visible is the stale $30.7M outlier.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 commentary (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2025/11/09/eton-pharma-eton-q3-2025-earnings-transcript, via search snippet). Same Q2 8-K as findings 1 and 2, different line.

findings.finding: The Earnings Whispers preview flags a possible release of the ~$22M deferred-tax valuation allowance, now that Eton is profitable. A release in Q3 would lift GAAP EPS to roughly $1+ against the $0.34 consensus. It is non-cash and below operating income.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior allowance release on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline EPS consensus of $0.34 does not include it, so headline algorithms would read a large beat. Sized as a fraction because there is no path to operating guidance; the timing (Q3 or Q4) is unknown.

findings.finding: Insiders sold ~$25.4M of stock over 12 months with no purchases, including the CEO (100k shares at $60.88, filed 2026-08-20) and others after the Q2 print. The latest sale is the CBO's 4,166 shares at $55.07 on 2026-10-06, after an RSU vest.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CEO's August sales came after a +44% print and the stock has since drifted down 26% from its high. There is no print-level read on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the Form 4s are public and the stock is near its post-earnings low. Filed small as overhang.

findings.finding: Eton's Vermont new-drug price-transparency filing (18 V.S.A. 4637, sent 2026-06-03) estimates 13,000 patients may be prescribed HEMANGEOL. That compares with ~8,000 a year under Pierre Fabre and management's public 'ultimately >10,000'. Filing under the statute also confirms a launch WAC above the specialty threshold.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an obscure state filing, but its content overlaps management's public 10-15k addressable-patient estimate, so it is mostly priced. It supports volume runway in any 2027 commentary.
findings.independence: Management's 10-15k severe-hemangioma estimate, via MarketBeat Q2 call highlights (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/eton-pharmaceuticals-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-13/, snippet; page returned 403).

findings.finding: IMPAVIDO (miltefosine) US commercialisation started late September 2026 (8-K 2026-09-28). It contributes ~0 to Q3 revenue. Eton pays Knight 50-55% of net sales, so it is a low-margin line; the risk is that it is quoted as Q4/2027 upside.
findings.why_not_priced: Already in the preview, which notes little contribution expected. Filed for completeness.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q note on Knight terms (same URL as finding 1).

findings.finding: On 2026-11-02 Eton licensed Baylor College of Medicine IGF-1 patent rights for infantile and epileptic spasms (ET-900, mecasermin, i.e. INCRELEX), with first patient planned for Q1 2027. It adds R&D in 2027, extends INCRELEX lifecycle, and gives a call talking point. Terms were not disclosed.
findings.why_not_priced: Preclinical-to-clinical program with immaterial near-term P&L impact. Public three days before the print.

outside_window.finding: LIBERVANT full approval for ages 12+ is expected after VALTOCO orphan exclusivity expires on 2027-01-10. The ages 6-11 PDUFA is 2027-03-29, with launch April 2027 and a $10M first-sale milestone.
Possible $4M ALKINDI SPRINKLE sales milestone, expensed in Q4 2026; it was already in the EBITDA guide.

baseline_tension: No skew is available. The long lean runs against a -10% 20-day and -8% 5-day drift and heavy insider selling, but agrees with call-heavy open interest and the name's history of buying guidance raises. Implied move ~20% with a wide spread, against a median reaction of 7.5%.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (one-offs): valuation-allowance release cut from +0.5 to +0.3, since it has no path to operating guidance.
Rule 5 (positioning, not a filed cause): insider-selling finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2. Kept filed per the core.
Rule 5 (overlap with public series): Vermont 13,000-patient estimate cut from +0.3 to +0.2, since it overlaps management's public 10-15k estimate.
Rule 6 (bar): $42.2M is confirmed by two agreeing sources, so no cap. The $30.72M outlier and the stale $120.2M FY consensus are disregarded.

Rules 1, 4, 7, 9 checked. Raises have been bought on this name, so no reaction veto. LIBERVANT is funded from operating cash flow for a 2027 launch, so it is a margin-guide item, not distress. Short interest ~6.8% is not crowded. The HEMANGEOL finding is already sized net of the base business. No change from these.
